title: The specification approach to equilibrium states for parabolic rational maps
summary: We develop the specification and orbit-decomposition approach to equilibrium states for parabolic rational maps of the Riemann Sphere. Our result extends the well-known results on uniqueness of equilibrium states in this setting, notably the results of Denker, Przytycki and Urbański. We extend the class of potentials from Hölder to those with the Bowen property on 'good orbits' . We obtain uniqueness of the equilibrium state for potentials satisfying a pressure gap condition which is sharp in the class of potentials we consider.
